strategy: Freeze the existing method-first planner and interval updater; keep the complete experiment-method library and native measured feedback. Record actual chosen methods. Do not substitute a new midpoint algorithm or scientific parameter.
horizon_basis: Current supported width approximately 0.0027484. Adjacent representatives do not guarantee balanced contraction; 64 is a finite cap covering about sixty one-eighth contractions, not a convergence claim. Stop sooner when the original gate is met or no complete useful segment is available.

confirmation_protocol.selection_rule: Panel identifier and seed offset fixed before this unit; expose outcomes only after the existing confirmation gate passes. No replacement.
confirmation_protocol.comparator: The actual selected 180-row predictor at unit registration, versus the final selected predictor frozen before observation.
confirmation_protocol.failure_rule: Retain the failure and end this unit without a new fit, threshold change, seed change or additional confirmation.

scope: Finish one already revised source before independent successor validation; not a new independent physical source, method pair or ABC claim.
accounting: Allocate from the unassigned portion of the already authorized 6500000 only. Preserve old221, every existing source balance, failures and unknown cost intervals. Charge every new phase once, including failed work; keep all retained candidates and use paid suffix scores.
stop_rule: One bounded continuous unit. Stop on confirmation outcome, no executable distinction, instrument mismatch, incomplete interval update, insufficient complete-segment budget, observation reserve, 64 probes, 7200-second activity cutoff, or less than512MiB mount space. No automatic follow-up unit.
